panels.description: Live PeerConnections and Room actors. Phase 6 ref: 11-peer storm peaked ~30 MB RSS / 8 MB heap; gauges must return to 0 at idle (layer-distribution leak fix, postmortem phase-6 §8.3).
panels.title: SFU Peers / Rooms

panels.description: RTP packets written to downlinks vs dropped on queue saturation. Phase 6 ref: 0 drops (synthetic 30 fps never fills the 100-packet inbox). Drop ratio = drops / forwarded.
panels.title: SFU Forwarded vs Dropped

panels.description: Aggregated depth of subscriber packet queues (backpressure signal). Phase 6 ref: 0 throughout the suite. Inbox cap is 100 packets; sustained values above 0 mean the forwarder cannot keep up.
panels.title: SFU Subscriber Queue Depth

panels.description: Viewer NACKs received vs translated+forwarded, plus RTX repair outcomes. NACK >= 20/s forces a layer DOWN (layer_selector.go); unmatched repairs have no reverse seq mapping.
panels.title: SFU NACK / RTX Repair Rates

panels.description: Viewer keyframe requests (PLI/FIR) in vs limiter output to publishers. Phase 6 ref: 30 received -> 2 forwarded (15:1, 500 ms limiter). Storm ratio = received / forwarded.
panels.title: SFU PLI / FIR Rates

panels.description: Video downlinks per simulcast layer right now. Phase 6 ref: f=1, h=1, q=1 distinct layers under clean/degraded/severe profiles. Must return to 0 at idle.
panels.title: SFU Layer Distribution

panels.description: Simulcast layer switch events by direction. Phase 6 ref: 3 DOWN / 0 UP, bounded, no flap (8-switch budget). 10 s cooldown per (sub, pub); UP needs 5 clean windows.
panels.title: SFU Layer Switches

panels.description: Latest average packet-loss fraction from subscriber Receiver Reports. Static gates from layer_selector.go: DOWN at >= 5% loss EWMA, UP only at <= 1% over 5 windows.
panels.title: SFU Fraction Lost

panels.description: PROXY for plan/09 §5 send-to-render p99 < 150 ms: API p99 + gateway fan-out p99. True client render timing is uninstrumented; this sums the two server-side segments. Alert SLOSendToRenderP99High fires after 5 m above 150 ms. See also Gateway Fan-Out Latency panel (fan-out SLO 50 ms, alert SLOFanoutP99High).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(api_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m]))) + histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(gateway_fanout_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])))

panels.title: Send-to-Render p99 (proxy)

panels.description: Projected SFU egress per 30 d from the 5 m forwarded-packet rate x 1200 B avg packet (postmortem phase-6 §8.1). Alert EgressMonthlyProjectionHigh fires after 15 m above 7 TB. Replaces the screen-share quota idea per #84.
panels.title: Monthly Egress Projection

panels.description: Trend of the 30 d egress projection (same query as the stat). Red line marks the 7 TB alert threshold.
panels.title: Egress Projection Trend
